checks.text: The page shows the heading "Alarm Clock" and, with no alarms saved, the text "No alarms yet".

In the "New alarm" form, typing "07:30" in the field labelled "Time", typing "Morning" in the field labelled "Label", and clicking the button "Add alarm" adds a list item containing "07:30" and "Morning"; the text "No alarms yet" is no longer visible.
After adding the alarm from A2, clicking the button "Delete Morning" removes that list item and the text "No alarms yet" is visible again.
Clicking the tab "Timer" switches the main view to the timer; the button "Start" is visible and the large clock display shows "00:00".

In the Timer view, clicking the preset button "5 min" changes the large clock display to "05:00"; clicking "Start" changes the button label to "Pause" and the display begins counting down from "05:00".
In the Timer view, after starting a 5-minute timer, clicking "Pause" changes the button label to "Resume" and the large clock display stops changing for at least 2 seconds.
In the Timer view, clicking "Reset" while a timer is paused or running changes the large clock display to "00:00" and the button label to "Start".
In the "New alarm" form, clicking "Add alarm" with an empty "Time" field shows the message "Enter a time" and adds no list item.
Reload keeps the alarm added in A2: after reloading the page, the list item containing "07:30" and "Morning" is still present.
